value.rationale: The minimal nontrivial fixed-cardinality 2-agent 4-good allocation has exactly three possible pairings; this theorem supplies the complete best/intermediate/worst order for every independent atomless FSD-ordered law, including heterogeneous exponentials not handled by common convolution-power results. Identical-law backgrounds extend the law to larger markets, and a strict means-only counterexample proves that a weaker natural ordering is insufficient.
